args.sql:
SELECT 
    t4.primdx AS diagnosis_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT t2.patkey) AS number_of_patients,
    SUM(t3.crisisint) AS total_crisis_interventions
FROM 
    encounters AS t1
JOIN 
    patients AS t2 ON t1.patref = t2.patkey
JOIN 
    treatmentbasics AS t3 ON t1.enckey = t3.encref
JOIN 
    assessmentsocialanddiagnosis AS t4 ON t1.abref = t4.asdkey
GROUP BY 
    t4.primdx
ORDER BY 
    total_crisis_interventions DESC
LIMIT 10;
